$comment: BUILD view of packages/nuxt (TASK-S2-O1). Same shape and same reason as packages/contracts/tsconfig.build.json: tsconfig.json is the typecheck view, this is what `yarn build` compiles. Two overrides matter. (1) `rootDir: ./src` + emit, so the published layout stays dist/module.js and dist/module.d.ts -- unchanged from before this file existed. (2) `paths` drops the `@dzup-ui/contracts` -> source mapping that tsconfig.base.json installs. A BUILT package must compile against the same published declarations a consumer receives (`@dzup-ui/contracts` -> dist/index.d.ts via its own `exports`), not against sibling source: resolving to source both violates rootDir and emits stray .js/.d.ts into packages/contracts/src. Specs are excluded so none ships.
